**Resubmitted: INDEMN — missing, cured at the fallback level.**

Repair made in response to the verifier's intent defect:

- The `numbering` field was not being rendered into the paragraph text, leaving the insertion unlettered while its cap sentence referred to "this Section 9(c)" — a dangling cross-reference. The "(c)" designation is now carried **inside the inserted paragraph text itself**, so the paragraph reads "(c) HDI shall indemnify the Company..." in line with 9(a) and 9(b), and the cap's reference to Section 9(c) resolves to a subsection that exists.
- The comment now records the optional preferred-level upgrades (duty to defend, Company affiliates, notice/control/cooperation) as a negotiating note only, not as a substitute for operative language.

Unchanged and confirmed: all seven fallback elements sit in operative text (IP indemnity for the Site and HDI's services; modification/combination/specification exclusions; procure–modify–replace with fee refund fallback; 3× twelve-month fee super-cap); no "or Content" carve-out; Sections 9(a) and 9(b) including the Globix carve-out retained verbatim; no survival tail, attorneys'-fees, or at-own-expense extras; elementCoverage maps each fallback element exactly once to operation 1.
